_about: Reserve Passport seed list. Scope: government-run (national + provincial) reserves open to visitors; no private or municipal reserves, no marine-only areas. Province = province of the MAIN GATE for reserves spanning several. Edit this file, then run scripts/reserves/fetch-coordinates.mjs and scripts/reserves/build.mjs. 'check' = needs a human to confirm (status, name, or whether it belongs).
